request.query:
GOAL: A short note the person keeps open while booking or at the service desk: which service to choose, what to write in a free-text field, what to bring and when they plan to go, all from the facts. Not an email: no request for a reply.

FACTS:
P1: I arrive in Helsinki on 1 December 2026.
P2: I am an EU citizen, moving to Helsinki for work and study.
F1: How to book: migri.vihta.com
F2: Opening hours: New IHH appointments open Thursdays 14-16 for the following week
F3: Bring: valid passport or identity card
F4: Bring: proof of grounds for residence in Finland (e.g. employment or studies)
F5: Bring: proof of sufficient financial resources
F6: Bring: authorised translation of attachments not in Finnish, Swedish or English
F7: Bring: debit or credit card for paying the fee if not paid online
F8: How long it takes: immediately at the service point if requirements are met and attachments are complete
P3: I plan to go (Migri) on 1 December 2026.

data.subject: Notes for my Migri residence registration visit

sentences.text: I plan to go to Migri on 1 December 2026.
I book at migri.vihta.com, where new IHH appointments open on Thursdays 14-16 for the following week.
In the free-text field I can write: "I am an EU citizen moving to Helsinki for work and study and would like to register my right of residence."
I bring my valid passport or identity card.
I also bring proof of grounds for residence in Finland (e.g. employment or studies) and proof of sufficient financial resources.
Any attachment not in Finnish, Swedish or English needs an authorised translation.
I bring a debit or credit card to pay the fee if I have not paid it online.
If the requirements are met and the attachments are complete, the matter is handled immediately at the service point.
